reviewer: Codex /root/opencv_review, single AI post-output source adjudication; not human-validated
method: All selected Type1/Type2 groups inspected with Git source, surrounding diffs and actual result subtrees. Artifact XPath nodes and full revision projections checked against Git where resolvable. Indices are zero-based results.json moves indices. Repeated groups and SIMD preprocessor displacement uncertainties remain unresolved. Carried fragments do not count as independent whole movements. No frozen labels changed.
limitations: Ordinary05 frozen review missed rename-source lapack.cpp; this case is not a source-complete negative and the ordinary window cannot support complete recall.
Ordinary06/09/14 contain unresolved preprocessor restructuring and repeated occurrences. Their emitted matches are not accepted as independent historical moves.
Whole typedef targets receive only selected function_decl children lacking typedef keyword; record descendant_only, never exact whole detection.
